map.📖 查看「工资税后计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "After-Tax Salary Calculator user guide"
map.月应纳税所得额 = 应发工资 − 五险一金 − 基本减除费用（5000 元/月）: Monthly taxable income = gross salary - social insurance and housing fund - basic deduction (5000 yuan/month) - special additional deductions; cumulative taxable income = monthly taxable income × number of months paid this year; cumulative tax due = cumulative taxable income × withholding rate - quick deduction; tax withheld this month = cumulative tax due through this month - cumulative tax due through last month; take-home this month = gross salary - social insurance - tax withheld this month
map.按综合所得年度税率表（7 级超额累进）做累计预扣：先把每月收入扣掉五险一金、50: Cumulative withholding under the annual comprehensive income tax table (7 progressive brackets): each month's income has social insurance and housing fund, the 5000 yuan basic deduction and special additional deductions removed, then tax is computed cumulatively by months paid this year; this month's tax = cumulative tax due - cumulative tax already withheld through last month. The tool assumes the same income and deductions for months 1-N of the year and ignores year-end bonuses, service income and annual settlement refunds or payments.
map.五险一金个人缴纳（元/月）: Social insurance and housing fund (employee share, yuan/month)
map.按累计预扣法测算个税与到手工资: Estimate tax and take-home pay under cumulative withholding
map.比较不同五险一金与专项附加扣除下的实发: Compare net pay under different social insurance and special deduction settings
map.为什么年初和年末个税不同？: Why does the tax differ between the start and end of the year?
map.累计预扣法下，累计所得跨入更高税率档后，后期月份的预扣税额会增加，属正常现象。: Under cumulative withholding, once cumulative income crosses into a higher bracket later months carry more withholding; this is normal.
map.专项附加扣除有哪些？: Which special additional deductions are available?
map.子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息或租金、继续教育、大病医疗、婴幼儿照护等，需据实: Child education, elderly care, mortgage interest or rent, continuing education, major medical expenses and infant care, all declared as applicable.
map.结果和工资条不一致？: Why does the result differ from my payslip?
map.基本减除费用（免征额）5000 元/月，五险一金与专项附加扣除可税前扣除；两者是: The basic deduction (threshold) is 5000 yuan/month; social insurance and housing fund and special additional deductions are both pre-tax deductions; they are two separate items and are not combined
map.专项附加：子女教育 2000/月、房贷利息 1000/月、房租 800-1500: Special deductions: child education 2000/month, mortgage interest 1000/month, rent 800-1500/month and so on
map.按累计预扣法测算：假设本年 1–N 月每月收入与扣除相同，月数直接参与累计计税，: Cumulative withholding: assuming the same income and deductions for months 1-N, the month count feeds directly into cumulative taxation rather than multiplying a single month's tax by the number of months
map.未计年终奖、劳务报酬、年度汇算补退税与各地五险一金基数上下限；结果仅供参考，正式: Year-end bonuses, service income, annual settlement refunds or payments and regional social insurance base floors and caps are excluded; results are for reference only, and official figures are determined by the tax authority
map.年度内任意月份个税税额的预估: Estimate of the monthly tax for any month in the year
map.示例：应发 2 万、五险一金 3 千、专项 2 千: Example: gross 20k, social insurance 3k, special deductions 2k
map.首月累计预扣：应税 10000 元 → 预扣税 790 元，到手约 20000-: First month's cumulative withholding: taxable 10000 yuan → withholding tax 790 yuan, take-home about 20000-3000-790 = 16210 yuan (excluding other deductions).
map.基数、比例与扣除项因单位与城市而异，请以单位申报与工资条为准。: Bases, rates and deduction items vary by employer and city; rely on your employer's filing and your payslip.
